name: Wild Boar Habitat Suitability Modelling for France
description: Code-only Python workflows for seasonal presence-background habitat suitability modelling of Sus scrofa in mainland France, comparing multitemporal and training-year-averaged MaxEnt and LightGBM models with leave-one-year-out evaluation, bias-aware background sampling and environmental diagnostics.
runtimePlatform: Python 3.10 or newer; compatible geospatial native libraries required

affiliation.name: Institute Geomatics, FHNW; Department of Geography, University of Zurich

citation.name: Wild Boar Collision Data and Satellite Computer Vision Refine Habitat Suitability Mapping across France

softwareRequirements: See requirements.txt; a complete historical environment is not included.
